title: Portland police see nine discs

tellings.quote: Portland 1947 July uh five law five police officers see uh a total of nine discs going different directions.

plain: In July 1947 in Portland, Oregon, five police officers saw a total of nine discs flying in different directions. A guest named Marik von Rennenkampff tells this from the raw reports of Project Sign, the US Air Force's first study of UFO sightings in the late 1940s, and offers it as a case seen by several trained witnesses.
